pump_force_characterization.scope: Separate10-device native charge-pump plus unchanged3-device finite filter fixture, not an alternative loop or a physical570 PASS. Uses exact pump subcircuit; external UP/DOWN ports are the only commands.
pump_force_characterization.measurement: Record actual clamp current, source/sink terminal currents and compliance throughout complete finite capture after settled bounds. Both-on state reports overlap behavior; never use it to infer ideal matched cancellation.
pump_force_characterization.sign_definition: For a voltage source VCTRL from control node toground, positive i(VCTRL) is current sunk by the clamp, hence net circuit charging current into the control node. Verify this sign with a small deterministic current/voltage-source control before interpreting native results.
pump_force_characterization.effective_force: At each safe full570 idle point, Jsource=mean_i(VCTRL)_570_idle + mean_i(VCTRL)_13_source - mean_i(VCTRL)_13_idle; Jsink analogously. Filter and idle-pump contributions cancel in the difference, leaving the measured loaded physical clock/filter plus the commanded pump force. Report independent subwindow ranges as well as whole means.
pump_force_characterization.reachability: Find connected grid intervals where Jsource>0 and Jsink<0 with the sign unchanged in all three subwindows. Bracket force zeroes and refine each sign-change interval by deterministic midpoint subdivision up to four levels (6.25mV grid resolution); unresolved or unsafe intervals remain unqualified. This is a necessary quasistatic bidirectional-control condition, not an absolute transient reachable-set proof.
